notes: INSIDE half of the Grundl Barge Flak: a huge ammo drum with a ribbed feed chute to the right (the ammo rack sits beside it), a heavy gear, hatch, power coupling and five amber lamps. damaged: the drum dented and the belt slipping; disabled: the drum jammed with a round stuck. The rotating head grundl_barge_flak_barrel swivels in the ring: four fat banded barrels in a riveted cradle with a drum feeding a chain belt, and a sensor lamp; fire: the barrels flash in turn. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
